hooks: Staring at an open fridge wondering what to cook tonight?
Tired of wasting groceries you forgot were in your fridge?
Do you ever struggle to make dinner from leftover ingredients?
hook_card_prompt: Warm modern kitchen counter with soft morning sunlight, fresh vegetables in a rustic wooden bowl, shallow depth of field, gentle cinematic lighting

problem.voice_line: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

claims.text: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

demos.voice_line: Photograph your open fridge to detect your ingredients. The camera screen captures the open fridge. The app detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge.

claims.text: Photograph your open fridge to detect your ingredients.
The camera screen captures the open fridge.
The app detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge.

demos.voice_line: Discover meals tailored to what is in your fridge. Three recipe cards slide in. Matched ingredients are highlighted on each card. The app suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use.

claims.text: Discover meals tailored to what is in your fridge.

how.voice_line: Computer vision detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge. The backend ranks recipes by how many of your ingredients they use.

impact.voice_line: Home cooks stop wasting food and save time by cooking with what they already have.
